correctness.rationale: Tree edge vectors are linearly independent, so each Gaussian comparison sign pattern uniquely labels a zonotope vertex. Projection to the zero-sum hyperplane preserves all coordinate comparisons; normal ranks of independent Gaussians become independent uniform ranks. Conditioning on hub uniforms u,u′,v,v′ gives C=∫ 1_{(u-v)(u′-v′)>0}a(u,u′)^p a(v,v′)^q with a=uu′+(1-u)(1-u′). Squaring the triangular beta-integral expansion proves the factorial double sum and rationality. Weighted hub-pair laws a^s/S_s concentrate in equal zero/one corners with rescaled independent Exp(1) coordinate deficits, yielding the central-edge match factor 1-theta(1-theta). The one-hub exact S_s=(s+1)^-2 sum_j binom(s,j)^-1 gives s² S_s->2. Independently enumerated exact rank permutations and matched formula for p,q=(1,1),(1,2),(2,2),(1,3),(2,3),(3,3); finite checks corroborate, corner-convergence proof supplies all diverging dimensions, including endpoint ratios theta=0,1.
residual_risks: Diagnostic finite computations alone cannot establish an infinite-dimensional or asymptotic assertion; unrestricted scope depends on reconstructed analytical argument.
